howToUse: css is authoritative. figmaCandidate is a GUESS at the Figma variable path: fig-tokens.css slugifies Figma names, so '/' and '-' are both flattened to '-'. Resolve by NORMALIZED name match against the live collections (strip / - _ and lowercase), never by exact string.

action per value: BIND = exact variable exists, bind it. BIND_NEAREST = perceptually identical (deltaE<2), bind nearest and move on. BIND_NEAREST_AND_FLAG = visible drift, bind nearest and print a diff note beside the frame. DS_REQUEST = no honest match, use the raw hex AND print a diff swatch on the canvas for human review. RAW_OK = board scaffolding, never ships, raw hex is fine.
Never invent a variable. If no candidate clears the bar, raw hex plus a printed diff is the correct outcome.
